role: CI gate: counts `Font.system(size: <numeric literal>)` calls (with or without the Font prefix, inside .font() or not) in the app target and in the watch target and fails above .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt / .ci/fixed_font_watch_budget.txt.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. BUDGET_FILE env or .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt; missing -> 66; non-integer -> 65. SOURCE_ROOT=$1 or Emuqu; WATCH_ROOT=$2 or 'EmuquWatch Watch App'. count/watch_count = measure(...) || exit $? (missing root or no Swift files -> 66). Watch budget missing -> 66, non-integer -> 65. Fails if either exceeds; prints below-budget hints; on success appends app count (not watch) to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

units.does: Python over $1: exits 66 if the root is not a directory or holds no .swift files; counts, on non-// lines, every `(Font).system(size: X` whose first argument X is a numeric literal; prints the count.
